goal: Put the car, electric toothbrush, hammer and shoe into the box, each oriented with its front facing the same way (left), with the box upright and aligned, then return both arms to the start pose.
instruction_templates: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
success: All at the same action boundary:
Box: box local z within 15 deg of world up (is_axis_up default, repeated per item); box local +y OR -y axis within 40 deg of world +x (3-D angle).

For each of car, electric_toothbrush, hammer: (1) its origin xy lies inside the quadrilateral of the box's 4 passive 'box_bottom' functional points (is_pointA_in_B_functional_bbox; xy only, tol 1e-6 m); (2) the box's local +y OR -y axis is within 45 deg of the object's 'checkpoint' (active functional point) local +x axis, both projected onto the xy plane; (3) the object's 'checkpoint' local -x axis, projected onto xy, is within 60 deg of world +x.

For shoe: (1) shoe origin xy inside the box_bottom quadrilateral; (2) box local +y OR -y within 45 deg of the shoe's root local +x axis (xy projection); (3) shoe root local +x axis (xy projection) within 60 deg of world +x.

all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, at the same action boundary as all other conditions. Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. No early-fail rule.
objects: car: toy car (category car, idx 0,6,7), 1, x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.25,0.0] (table frame), random yaw 360 deg
electric_toothbrush: (category electric_toothbrush, idx 0-3), 1, same region, random yaw
hammer: (category hammer, idx 0-4), 1, same region, random yaw
shoe: (category shoe, idx 0-7), 1, same region, random yaw
box: open storage box (category box), 1, x in [-0.30,0.30], y in [-0.10,0.0], yaw up to +-25 deg
needs_memory_or_language: The only orientation info is the instruction's 'front sides facing left'; in code this is world +x for the 'checkpoint -x' axis (car, toothbrush, hammer) or the root +x axis (shoe), each within 60 deg, so the asset 'front' convention is needed (checkpoint is an asset-defined functional point).
end_requirements: all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, (part of the success condition). Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
notes: Containment is only an xy test of the object's origin against the box_bottom polygon (no height test), so the object may even be lying on the box rim in principle; the box must remain nearly level (15 deg) and have its long axis within 40 deg of the world x axis (the box is sampled with only +-25 deg yaw so it normally satisfies this at start, but pushing the box can break it). The _random/non-random pair differ only in object model index sets (this one: car {0,6,7}, toothbrush {0..3}, hammer {0..4}, shoe {0..7}). Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
